building.name: The Archives
building.story_role: A severe, windowless knowledge fortress whose ground floor acts as the controlled public threshold into the deeper Archives.
building.source_policy: Canon-constrained reconstruction. This file is source-of-truth blockout data; image-draft details are marked reconstructed unless supported by higher evidence.
notes: The Archives remain treated as severe, stone, windowless, and institutionally controlled.
The ground floor now carries the major visible zones from the current plan image so Blender/Godot blockouts are navigable and recognisable.
Support rooms, exact proportions, shaft positions, furniture, stair runs, and partition placement are reconstructed from the visual draft, not promoted to canon.

validation_flags.message: This file remains the source-of-truth blockout draft for Archives ground-floor Godot testing.
All dimensions, proportions, wall thicknesses, room partitions, stair placements, and furniture positions are approximate reconstruction.
Several visible plan-image details have been added for spatial readability, but are tagged reconstructed and should not be treated as canon.
Scriv's Office, Transcription, Copying Room, Scriv's Rest, Lamp Larder, Catalogue Room, Unpacking, and Vertical Transport Shaft are reconstructed visual-draft features.
The public/restricted hierarchy is preserved: exterior, entrance, antechamber, Tomes, Scrivs Only, Stacks, restricted shelving, lower access.
Stacks are still represented as threshold and access logic; no final shelving grid, named districts, deep levels, or internal book-city layout is locked in this ground-floor test.
